verdict.rationale: Greptile's docs say users can configure review triggers and PR filters through greptile.json or the dashboard. The CLI's `greptile review` gives an on-demand review of a branch diff. However, the evidence never names the specific controls the story asks for. Missing for 10: explicit skip-draft-PR setting, explicit branch and label filter documentation, an on-demand PR trigger such as a comment mention, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I control when reviews run — skip drafts, trigger on demand, filter by branch or label — so the bot shows up only when wanted

citations.quote: Control review behavior, PR filters, file patterns, custom context, and output formatting.
Run `greptile review`, get a review of the feature branch diff in 60 seconds.
